# Site check (after T-033): mychata.cz, 14 Oct 2026

This is the fourth site check today, run at about 23:06 UTC after PR #40 (T-033) was merged and published. The earlier ones are `2026-10-14-site-check.md`, `-2.md` and `-3.md`. The check was read-only: nobody signed in, no forms were submitted, no buttons were clicked and no data was changed. The invalid links used made-up tokens, not any cottage's real links.

## Summary

- **Live commit: `c099891`** (`c099891d5f6e7dc9c757d03be6f2e236322c0665`, merge of PR #40, T-033), read from `<meta name="build-sha">` on `/auth`. `build-time` is `2026-10-14T22:46:46.725Z`. This is the current head of `main`.
- 6 of 6 e2e smoke tests pass. None of the 5 pages has console errors, page errors or failed first-party requests.
- T-033 fixes are live: the "Firemní chata" placeholder is gone from `/verejne/zadost/x`, and CLS on `/host/x-…` dropped from 0.11 to 0.0043.
- Tab icon, single `og:image` on `mychata.cz/brand/`, seasonal photo from `/assets/`, and Czech titles all pass.
- Still open: the cookie banner card floats about 12.75px above the bottom edge at 375px (unchanged). New: the hero photo is downloaded twice on each page load.

Biggest resources on `/auth`: `chata-autumn-DIt40PoD.webp` (380 KB, **fetched twice**), `index-smFpCHBB.js` (182 KB transferred, 625 KB decoded), `styles-BUATXI-P.css` (16 KB). INP was not measured, because no clicks were made. These numbers are not a DevTools trace.

## Smaller findings

- The hero webp shows two resource-timing entries of 379,708 bytes each per load: the page has both `<link rel="preload" as="image" fetchPriority="high">` and the `<img>`. Likely a preload/`<img>` mismatch (e.g. `crossorigin` or `imagesrcset`) or a re-render after hydration; cause not investigated. Costs 380 KB per visit on mobile.
- `/verejne/zadost/x` has no h1 or h2 on the invalid-link state (the "Firemní chata" heading was removed, nothing replaced it).
- The 380 KB hero photo is still large for a 375px screen.

## E2E output

The DevTools MCP was not available. `E2E_BASE_URL=https://mychata.cz bun run e2e` failed as-is because `node_modules` is not installed in this cloud copy:

```
$ playwright test
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package '@playwright/test' imported from /home/user/mychata/playwright.config.ts
error: script "e2e" exited with code 1
```

`tests/e2e/public.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.ts` were copied unchanged into a scratch folder; only the import (`@playwright/test` → `playwright/test`, global 1.56.1) was changed, and the tests ran with `E2E_BASE_URL=https://mychata.cz`:

